sloka: त्वम् कत्थसे महा राज सत्य वादी द्Rढ व्रतः ।मम च इमम् वरम् कस्मात् विधारयितुम् इच्चसि ॥२-१३-३॥
transliteration: tvam katthase mahā rāja satya vādī dRḍha vrataḥ ।mama ca imam varam kasmāt vidhārayitum iccasi ॥2-13-3॥

translations.english: O great king you used to boast that you always speak the truth and are steadfast in your vows. Why are you now seeking to avoid granting me this boon?
